title: Ila Sachani: Embroidering Dreams with Her Feet

summary.synopsis: An inspiring biographical story about Ila Sachani from Gujarat, who was born without functional hands. Through determination and non-stop practice, she trained her feet and toes to perform daily tasks and master Kathiawar embroidery with intricate mirror work, achieving state awards and financial independence.
